content.short: LN Exchange is the first spot and perpetual orderbook DEX on Bitcoin and the Lightning Network.
content.description: LN Exchange is the first spot and perpetual orderbook DEX on Bitcoin and the Lightning Network. Developed in 2024 and powered by Lnfi Network, it requires no KYC. All transaction data is trackable, tamper-resistant, fully transparent, and publicly viewable. The platform offers low, competitive fees and enables trading of spot, USDT-M, and ALTCOIN-M perpetual contracts.
